clue.text: Expert not entirely unknown, penning book demonstrating musical form

indicators.note: to pen something is to enclose it, so the shortened expert holds the book letter
the synonym for expert loses its final letter, so it is not all there

parts.note: a crack shot or crack player is an expert
anon, short for anonymous, means of unknown name

explanation.surface: A not-quite-anonymous expert writes a book showing off some musical structure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not entirely' trims CRACK to CRAC, and 'penning' puts B inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A crab canon is a contrapuntal form in which one voice plays the theme backwards against itself, so it is a musical form.

clue.text: Account tricked one American in Scotland

parts.note: CA is the abbreviation for a chartered accountant, someone who keeps the accounts
to lead someone on is to deceive or trick them
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.definitionFit: Caledonia is the old Latin name for northern Britain, still used poetically for Scotland.

clue.text: Significant opposition for each criminal

clue.text: Aerial transport, not entirely dangerous, passing through rocky outcrop

parts.note: clift is an old variant spelling of cliff, a rocky outcrop

explanation.walkthrough: 'not entirely' reduces HAIRY to HAIR; CLIFT is an archaic spelling of cliff.
explanation.definitionFit: A ski lift carrying seats on an overhead cable is transport through the air.

explanation.walkthrough: 'Repeatedly' gives SS, which 'avoiding' strips from the end of NEEDLESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Needle as a noun is irritation or provocation, especially hostility between rivals.

clue.text: Close agreement overturned — it's the drink

clue.text: Part of Wales filled after Derby emptied

explanation.walkthrough: Derby is an English city; 'emptied' leaves DY.
explanation.definitionFit: Dyfed is a preserved county of south-west Wales, so a region within the country.

clue.text: What desiccation (last of water going) implies?

definitions.text: What desiccation (last of water going) implies?

indicators.note: going means departing, so that letter leaves the synonym for desiccation

parts.note: desiccation is the process of drying out

indicators.note: last of picks out the final letter of the word water

explanation.surface: A puzzle about what drying out, with the very last water vanishing, really means.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing R (the 'last of water') from DRYING leaves the answer; read whole, the clue says desiccation that removes the last water means death.
explanation.definitionFit: When every last drop of moisture is lost, a living thing perishes, so desiccation implies death approaching.

clue.text: Departed without undertaking to provide nourishment

clue.text: Shelve with greater skill, taking little time

T is the short form, a little word, for time

clue.text: Guilt is disputed — I love getting involved, being this?

definitions.text: Guilt is disputed — I love getting involved, being this?

clue.text: Intellectual announcement, with end moved forward

clue.text: C-charity around home, mostly, still

clue.text: Major Biblical prophet's written about start of union, of dubious union
